content.text: Nothing I can verify for Saturday, Aug 8 that suits a 5 and an 8 year old. The only class that came up is a toddler one, so I left it out. High Park is a good fallback, and Saturday looks dry and warm at about 29. It has the Jamie Bell Adventure Playground, a free animal display with bison, llamas and peacocks, and a wading pool and splash pads. It's open daily, and the water play is seasonal.
